title: French Tagine with Earthy Vegetables
description: A rich and flavorful French-inspired tagine dish packed with lovely earthy vegetables and a blend of cheeses.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add the sliced onions and cook until they are softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
3. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
5. Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add the crumbled feta and goat cheese, and stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined.
7. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
